reference_frame: Departure rest frame; Newtonian linear V1 as 20_FIRST_IGNITION (gamma is not applied to the kinematics)
rationale: Ordering from the owner rules: spin down, stop and lock before high thrust (08!A47, MEC-011, 11!J4); the radiators run high-power rejection while the drive runs and post-shutdown cooldown after it (07!A39). Q53 (15!A100, 20!A25:A27, 08!H47): First Ignition starts from conditioned COAST with the coolant loop online (the induction boards docked, spins up and tours in COAST; the newcomer's departure is Tale-owned and not played); once thrust stops, the high-g locks release and isolation is verified, the paired spin-up may run while the hot-blade cooldown continues, with no wait for ambient blade temperature. No radiator cell-loss onset, time or fraction is shown (20!A27, OD-028). Frame budgets are display choices: the burn plays linearly in time, every other phase is a readable length.
open_question: Durations stay with the owner's OPEN items: spin-down (MEC-010, S6), startup and release thresholds (20!E25:E26), cooldown (S4) and drive start and stop (S7, OD-009); the radiator failure clock is OPEN until real heat inputs exist (20!A27, OD-028).

classes.SOURCED: An owner value or rule as stated, or a row of the sheet-computed route as imported.
classes.DERIVED: Computed from sourced values by a shared formula.
classes.PRESENTATION: Display timing or shape chosen for the animation: endpoints follow the sourced configurations, the instants and curves do not.
classes.UNKNOWN: Declared by FRM-002-2026-10-10 (FLIGHT-FRAMES 15!A117) and not released by Sheets: no keys, the value is null, never a number (15!H125).

kinematics.basis: 23_ROUTE_FRAMES rows 1..900 (WAYFARER_001_IGNITION_V1, DIAGNOSTIC_1D_FIRST_IGNITION), one row per timeline frame of the burn, linear between them (26_BLENDER_CONTRACT C-003/C-010); computed by the owner's sheet (NAV-027), Newtonian V1.

frame_channels.source: 15_MODEL_INTERFACES!A125:I125 FRM-002 (WORKFLOW LOCKED / CHANNEL NUMERICS OPEN; 98_DECISION_LOG!A91; 26_BLENDER_CONTRACT C-017/C-018), refining 15!A117:I117 FLIGHT-FRAMES (98!A85)
frame_channels.rules: Sheets owns the numbers, states, units, sample times and validation flags; Claude imports, stages and replays only. UNKNOWN channels and streams carry null, never a number; no interpolation, resampling onto the 30 fps frames, smoothing or derived physics; untimed phases and events stay unplaced (15!G125, H125; C-017/C-018). Mission time is independent of the 24/30 fps presentation. The 1D route frames stay DIAGNOSTIC and not heliocentric (15!I117).

physics.center_of_mass.reason: Requires a sourced mass distribution; visual geometry does not define a centre of mass.

physics.inertia.reason: Requires a supported physical mass model.

physics.mass_distribution.reason: Component masses are sourced (physics.mass_budget) but the workbook gives no positions; visual volumes do not define physics.

physics.drive_outputs.reason: Generic drive outputs have not been solved/imported for P0.

habitat.transfer.magnetic_support.losses.reason: MEC-010 / S6: tracked separately from mechanical friction and never zero; no loss coefficient or controller power is sourced.

habitat.transfer.spin_down.reason: Controlled coast-down duration, braking torque, the touchdown thermal case and the control law are OPEN (MEC-010, OD-013). The WF_RING_STOP_LOCK and WF_ROTOR_TOUCHDOWN actions use PROTOTYPE display timing; only the sourced spin-up time exists.

power.hotel_source.reason: S7/OD-009: low-power fusion hotel mode versus an independent auxiliary source is still OPEN. Storage removes the need to keep fusion burning for restart only; it is not an independent long-duration hotel source.

power.degraded_modes.reason: OD-010 degraded-mode matrix (generator, rotor, coolant, nozzle faults) is unsolved; S7 requires a future FMEA.

physics.plume_boundary.reason: No quantitative plume boundary in inspected ship and Fiji propulsion/manifold ranges; 5/10/15/20 degree cones are geometry sensitivity hypotheses only.
physics.plume_boundary.study_case: 15 deg half-angle (15!G3); do not canonize (15!H3). Not a timeline channel.
